spanish: Y si mataras al pueblo este como varón uno, y dirán las naciones que oyeron tu fama, diciendo:

findings.issue: Unmarked «si» adds a condition. The token is only conjunction + hiphil perfect 2ms (you caused to die); «mataras» also turns that perfect into a hypothetical subjunctive.

notes: The remaining tokens match: object people-this, as man one, and the nations who heard your report will say, saying.
